sentences.en: People around me say that you are very outgoing.
sentences.zh: 我周围的人都说你很外向。

sentences.en: Layla was a brave, happy and outgoing little girl.
sentences.zh: 莱拉是个勇敢、快乐且外向的小女孩。

sentences.en: Add up your outgoings, putting on a bit more for contingencies.
sentences.zh: 把你的支出加起来，再加上一些以防万一。

senses.zh: 对人友好的，开朗的；出发的，外出的；即将离职的；乐于助人的
